analysis: Per-domain image-level defect-type versus normal ranking; other defect types excluded from each comparison.
duplicate_policy: Ambiguous exact duplicate test4 image excluded from defect-type analysis; source test0 excluded from shifted-domain macro.
limitations: Only the two matched PatchCore backbones are included; DINO subtype scoring was interrupted before producing complete results.
Metrics are descriptive; five reference selections reuse the same test images and are not independent dataset samples.
Image AP depends on the defect prevalence in each domain/type subset.
No fixed operating threshold or physical-board generalization is evaluated.
